steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It's the Hour of Ch'ou... Who won this round?

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Count for yourself.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I told you I'm not very good at this.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Then you should learn.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It is not easy to meet you face-to-face.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: A decrepit temple... just as unrelenting as you are. You lock yourself away in this hut to stare at that board day after day. What do you see, looking at it?

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: More or less what you see from your ledgers.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: There exist rules on the board, just as there exist rules outside the board.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: All under Heaven live for profit, and die for profit... Perceptive as always, Erge.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Over the years, our brothers and sisters seem to have lived much more pleasant lives after discovering their interests.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Our eldest brother seems to have eventually mastered kung fu and made his way north to guard the city there. Our eldest sister, on the other hand, dreamt a thousand years away and roamed hither and thither, living a most happy life.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: All of us live as happily as we can be... except her, you know the one.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: All these years... and I still feel sorry for her.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Business must've been going very well for you to have the time and luxury to worry about all this.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It wasn't until recently that I comprehended a certain wisdom and learnt a way to live.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Heaven and earth are merely a temporary lodging for all beings, while time is a transient guest that passes generations by...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Man spends an entire lifetime, only for a spiritual lodging and a persistant pursuit for accomplishments. Whether this lifetime is long or short makes little difference.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: If you were truly seeing everything through, you wouldn't be sitting here.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: I know what you're going to say.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: I can help you do what you want to do.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: However, I will need to borrow something from you in return.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: You're my second-eldest brother, no need to stand on ceremony. What's mine is yours.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Give me your life.

a.text: From what I've heard, I came to Dahuang from the villages outside.

That year, someone found a wooden basin in the fields with a child who barely knew how to speak. Most likely, he had drifted into the fields from the river that flowed outside the city. Good thing someone found him.
Considering there was news of a Catastrophe, it's not so difficult to make guesses as to what had happened upstream.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: You're a lucky boy, clinging on to dear life in a field of grain... We'll call you He Sheng, for 'Grain Stalks.'

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: This will be your home from now on.

a.text: I later asked around, in hopes of finding the village where I was born.
I found a 'village' that was completely empty. There was nothing but ruined houses and swaths of land covered in Originium crystals.
What happened to the people here?

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: The land here yields no harvest anymore.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Do you see the black rocks? You can't grow food anywhere you find them.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: And if you can't grow food, people go hungry.

a.text: Is there lots of land like this?
Is there any way we can make these bad rocks disappear, so we can grow food on this land again?

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Many people have spent many years looking for a way.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Would you like to join them?

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: It could take a very long time. You might never see the results. Even after spending your whole life on the effort.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Would you regret that?
A lot has happened lately. The land I knew is now completely different. The old fields were almost renovated. Too bad Heaven is cruel and forced these endless calamities upon us.
The farmer by the fields looks up to see the rain falling onto his face. It feels cool and gentle.
The withered crops in the field also stand up straight, their stalks and leaves returning to a crisp, green color.

steps.name: Astonished Farmer
steps.text: It's...

steps.name: Astonished Farmer
steps.text: Shennong...

steps.name: Astonished Farmer
steps.text: Shennong really is back...
Wei, what're you doing, lying around here?
Wake up. Hey, wake up!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: And why that getup again...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...What time is it?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It's been half a day since we last saw each other. You had me check the crops in the granary, and said you'd find the culprit behind all the storms in Dahuang. Why are you lying here?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So what's the story?!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How are the crops in the granary? Were they polluted? Have you found the source of the pollution?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You saw none of that...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I went to the granary, only to find the summer harvest all turned a strange red-black color... Not only that, but the soil in the fields is all crusty and salted.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I have no idea what happened, but it rained just moments ago, and not only did the soil return to normal, but so did the grains in the granary.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Almost like somebody used some tremendous Originium Arts to cleanse the taint.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The taint underground? Who could do that...?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: So we're safe now?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This rain...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where is Shu?!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Where is... who?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Your teacher! Where is she?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: We have a few teachers at the Tianshi Bureaus... Which one are you talking about...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What did you do?!

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: What ever do you mean?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: She's gone!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What are you up to?!

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Why ask me?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It has always been her decision alone to stay here and guard this place. When have I ever interfered in any way?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Was it not 'man' who locked her away in this land for a millennium?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Have you lost your marbles?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Not only do you and the weiqi failure want to get yourselves killed, you wanna drag all of us down with you?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Looks like my little sisters have spent too much time and had too much fun in this mortal realm... to the point that they've forgotten who they really are.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: How much longer will you two keep up this act, pretending you're not different?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Shut up—

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Dusk... you've been hiding in your paintings for so long, yet you are still as impatient as ever. Quite unbecoming of the world's greatest artist, wouldn't you say?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: And Nian. In all these years, I've never seen you so serious. Seems you actually care a lot about your siblings.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'm going to kill you.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: But as I told you, I am here to help... *cough*... Why won't you believe me?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Didn't you want to assemble this vessel of yours that will bear the energy of our existence? The Feranmut's Heart? May I tell you what it's missing right now?

spans.text: Didn't you want to assemble this vessel of yours that will bear the energy of our existence? The
May I tell you what it's missing right now?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Stay back, if you value your life.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I really don't have the luxury of resolving this misunderstanding right now... You two will just have to forgive me for this.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: How come you can control the device? When did you—

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Our powers came from the same source. On top of that, I deliberately studied a few methods of dealing with my doppelgangers.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: This might perhaps be a little risky and it comes with certain side effects, but that is something I will have to live with.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Dahuang should face this crisis. They should not be allowed to rely on others giving their lives to resolve what they have sown.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: That would simply be too convenient.
The man extends his hand, and a black bundle of rice stalks appears in his hand.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: 'Shape,' 'will,' and 'causality.' The three of you together may appear as though you can stand up to even Heaven itself.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: That is how our sister has always been. She believed that toiling away in the fields would always yield a good harvest. She believed the lands had more beauty than blemishes, more benevolence than wickedness.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: But why does the birth of new life always come with the sound of crying?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: When a frail new life is born on these lands, be it man or beast, the very first emotion it must feel is always fear.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It is time to wake up.
The man inserts the black rice stalks into the enormous device in front of him.
Moments later, a heart begins to beat.
